VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: WIT

The reviewer note raises a substantive technical concern about leap-second handling that could cause transactions to fall outside both periods—a gap in coverage that contradicts the agent's claim of complete resolution. While the agent reports all 118 tests passing, the self-report alone cannot validate that the solution handles all edge cases, particularly ones (like leap seconds) that may not be represented in the existing test suite. The witness-level concern about untested boundary conditions is sufficient to indicate the acceptance criteria have not been fully satisfied.
